audit: LiberiaLearn December Product Assurance + Red-Team Audit V1
method: Static repository audit (route/page/service reading, heuristic sweeps for unscoped IDs, nav reachability scan, token contrast computation) plus focused and hostile Vitest. No live Supabase/Vercel access; no staging/production mutation.

findings.finding: Discussion per-ID routes had no tenant/class scope: any TEACHER/ADMIN could approve moderation-held Grade 1-6 posts, delete, lock or pin threads in any school; a school ADMIN could read another school's thread posts; any STUDENT could flag/upvote/delete-own in classes they are not enrolled in.
findings.evidence: Routes called requireRole then acted on params id with findUnique/update and no class/school predicate; list/create routes already enforced enrollment/same-school.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant bypass of the child-post moderation hold and cross-tenant read of children's posts.
findings.fix: lib/discussion/access.ts applies the list/create scope rule to every per-ID route.

findings.finding: POST /api/packs/week trusted body.audience and body.classId: a STUDENT sending audience=teacher received an unstripped pack (answerKey, correctAnswer, modelAnswer, teacherNotes); any role could pack another school's class; a teacher with no classId generated an unscoped platform-wide pack.
findings.evidence: generatePack strips keys only when pack.audience === 'student'; scheduledWork query omits classId filter when classId is null.
findings.impact: Answer-key exposure to learners and cross-tenant access to school-private lessons.
findings.fix: Students are forced to the student edition and to an enrolled class; staff classId must be in their school; no class -> 400.

findings.finding: /teacher/student/[id] rendered any student's name, email, community/county, grades, homework and placement to any TEACHER nationally; the roster check was commented out ('For now just let them in'). It also displayed a fabricated default location ('New Kru Town, Montserrado') for students without one.
findings.evidence: teachesStudent computed but its redirect was commented out.
findings.impact: National cross-tenant child PII read; misleading learner data.
findings.fix: Enforces the getTeacherScope rule (enrolled in a class the teacher teaches at their school); shows 'Location not recorded'.

findings.finding: POST /api/certificates/[id]/share let a school ADMIN mint a public share link (containing the learner's name) for any school's certificate.
findings.evidence: Ownership check applied only to role STUDENT.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant publication of a child's name via a public URL.
findings.fix: Non-platform ADMIN must share the learner's school.

findings.finding: GET /api/moe/waec-readiness (reachable by MOE and school ADMIN) returned exact per-county and per-subject readiness averages for cohorts of 1-4 learners, unlike every other MOE aggregate which suppresses cohorts under 5.
findings.evidence: No MIN_COHORT check; county rows built from any n > 0.
findings.impact: Small-cell re-identification of individual learners' readiness.
findings.fix: Applies the existing 5-learner minimum; suppressed rows carry suppressed=true and render 'Fewer than 5 students'; zero stays 'no data'.

findings.finding: Guardian progress presented 'no evidence' as a zero score: a child with no scored work got avgScore 0 -> 'struggling' and home-intervention advice.
findings.evidence: average([]) returns 0; masteryLevelForScore(0) = 'struggling'.
findings.impact: Misleading family-facing educational judgement (unavailable != zero).
findings.fix: Aggregator exposes evidenceCount; route returns hasEvidence=false and the existing empty state renders.

findings.finding: Guardian progress always showed an arbitrary first linked child (no child switching) and queried evidence with the guardian's schoolId instead of the child's school.
findings.evidence: studentGuardian.findFirst without studentId/order; getStudentPerformanceSummary(link.studentId, user.schoolId).
findings.impact: Multi-child families cannot see each child; children at other schools show empty data.
findings.fix: ?studentId selection verified against links, deterministic default, child's school used, child selector in UI.

findings.finding: GET /api/packs/[packId]/download let any TEACHER/ADMIN download any pack by id (teacher packs contain answer keys and school-private lessons); the sibling metadata route already restricted to the requester.
findings.evidence: Requester check applied only to STUDENT.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant IDOR on private curriculum content.
findings.fix: Requester-only, 404 otherwise.

findings.finding: Legacy /assignments/[id] page let any student view any school's homework; POST /api/student/homework/[id]/submit accepted submissions to any class in the student's school.
findings.evidence: homework.findUnique by id only; submit scoped by schoolId only.
findings.impact: Cross-tenant content read; submissions attached to classes the learner does not belong to.
findings.fix: Both require enrollment in the homework's class (same rule as /student/assignments/[id]).

findings.finding: Lesson completion was not idempotent: a double-tap or retry after a lost response re-ran mastery update, streak, certificate check and guardian/teacher notification.
findings.evidence: StudentProgress upsert was idempotent but every side effect ran unconditionally.
findings.impact: One lesson counted as multiple mastery evidence events; duplicate paid SMS to guardians.
findings.fix: Identical resubmission of an already-completed lesson returns the stored result with no side effects. Whether a changed resubmission should count is left to educational policy.

findings.finding: POST /api/student/placement accepted any client band/levelLabel/estimatedGrade/rawScore (e.g. grade 12, rawScore > totalQuestions); a single teacher 'confirm' copies estimatedGrade into Student.currentGrade.
findings.evidence: Only typeof checks; band/label stored as sent.
findings.impact: Forged diagnostic evidence one click from an administrative grade change.
findings.fix: Superseded by server-authoritative placement V1; client payload endpoint retired (410).

findings.finding: Credential login failures were silent and indistinguishable (rate limited, unknown identifier, wrong PIN, inactive school, privileged MFA required).
findings.evidence: Every branch returned null with no record.
findings.impact: Support cannot tell a deactivated-school tenant outage or lockout from a mistyped PIN.
findings.fix: Fire-and-forget metric auth.login.failed with a reason code and schoolId only (never identifier or secret); login still fails closed if the metric write fails.

findings.finding: Portal links to pages that do not exist: /admin/dashboard (8 pages), /teacher/homework/create, /teacher/class, /guardian/lessons, /moe/audit, /student/leaderboard (sidebar).
findings.evidence: Static scan of literal hrefs against app/ page files.
findings.impact: Navigation dead ends (404) in every portal.
findings.fix: Repointed to existing pages; removed the MOE audit link (no MOE audit surface exists; see D11); added /student/leaderboard index that routes to the student's class board.

findings.finding: 134 solid yellow/accent surfaces (primary buttons incl. Sign out, placement, onboarding) used --ll-text-faint text: 3.15:1 contrast, below WCAG AA 4.5:1; many hovered to an 11%-alpha yellow, making text nearly invisible.
findings.evidence: Computed from app/globals.css tokens (#6b6460 on #E8B84B = 3.15:1; --ll-bg on yellow = 9.45:1).
findings.impact: Illegible primary actions on low-end screens and in sunlight.
findings.fix: Token swap to --ll-bg text (the pairing already used by the MOE dashboard) and hover:opacity-90 on those surfaces; no palette change.

findings.finding: NotificationBell: link items called markRead twice (unread count dropped by 2); non-link items were click-only divs (not keyboard operable); panel could overflow a 320px viewport.
findings.evidence: Nested onClick on Link and inner div; div onClick without role/tabindex; fixed w-80.
findings.impact: Wrong unread badge; keyboard users cannot dismiss.
findings.fix: Single handler; non-link items are buttons; max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)].
findings.closureTest: No DOM testing library in repo; covered by TypeScript and production build only.

findings.finding: Placement answer custody is client-side: /api/placement/generate-question returns correctAnswer before the learner answers, correctness is decided in the browser, and calculate-grade trusts client 'correct' booleans.
findings.evidence: submitAnswer compares selectedAnswer to currentQuestion.correctAnswer client-side.
findings.impact: Placement evidence remains forgeable within the now-enforced consistency bounds.
findings.fix: Server-authoritative placement V1: server-held session, answer custody, server scoring.

findings.finding: No support view for a single learner's offline sync state; only school-level gauges (offline.queue.pending/conflicts/dead_letter) and per-op resolutionHint returned to the device.
findings.evidence: Metrics recorded per request; no admin surface reads them per learner.
findings.impact: Stuck-sync and offline-conflict tickets cannot be diagnosed without DB access.
findings.fix: New admin surface - product decision.

findings.finding: /moe/live?token= signed display link cannot work unauthenticated: middleware requires a session for /moe/* and /api/moe/live before the token check runs.
findings.evidence: Neither path is in PUBLIC_PATHS.
findings.impact: Projector/TV display feature is dead.
findings.fix: MOE live display remains authenticated; signed display tokens are rejected and the issuer returns 410 until a kiosk credential is approved.

findings.finding: School ADMIN can read national/county WAEC readiness (/api/moe/waec-readiness ALLOWED includes ADMIN).
findings.evidence: ALLOWED = MOE_OFFICIAL, MOE_SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN.
findings.impact: Aggregate-only after F05; whether school admins see national data is policy.
findings.fix: National WAEC readiness restricted to MOE roles (PR #142).

findings.finding: GET /api/adaptive/scaffold/[variantId] returns any lesson variant body to any student.
findings.evidence: No lesson/class check.
findings.impact: Content only, no PII.

findings.finding: /api/portfolio/[shareCode] is not public (middleware requires a session) although it is a share link; any authenticated user with the code can read the portfolio summary.
findings.evidence: Not in PUBLIC_PATHS; no role check.
findings.impact: Share intent unclear.
findings.fix: No anonymous portfolio sharing: share codes require a session.

findings.finding: District-update and MOE-report agent tools aggregate WAEC readiness without small-cell suppression before feeding LLM drafts.
findings.evidence: aggregateWaecForStudents has no cohort minimum.
findings.impact: Small cohorts may appear in human-reviewed drafts.
findings.fix: Agent report tools apply lib/waec/suppression.ts (cohort < 5 withheld).

findings.finding: POST /api/discussion/posts does not verify parentPostId belongs to the same thread.
findings.evidence: parentPostId stored as sent.
findings.impact: Orphaned reply linkage; no data exposure.
findings.fix: Reply parentPostId must belong to the same thread.

findings.finding: /student, /teacher and /guardian layouts do not role-gate; every page/API must check its own role (F03 was a page that did not scope).
findings.evidence: Middleware role-gates only /admin, /moe, /platform.
findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap.
findings.fix: Middleware portal role gates for /student, /teacher, /guardian (defense in depth).

findings.finding: Any TEACHER in the school, not only the learner's teacher, can confirm/override a placement that sets Student.currentGrade.
findings.evidence: Scope check is same-school only; audited.
findings.impact: Promotion authority breadth is a policy question.
findings.fix: Official grade requires PLACEMENT_CONFIRM (school ADMIN); teachers hold PLACEMENT_REVIEW only.

findings.finding: MOE dashboard advertised a 'National audit trail' but no MOE audit surface exists (link removed in F13).
findings.evidence: No app/moe/audit page.
findings.impact: Whether MOE may read the audit log is policy.

lensPassEvidence.student: Lesson list strips payload (app/api/student/lessons/route.ts); completion is enrollment- and school-checked; completion now replay-safe (F10); unit/lesson routes bind to studentUserId. Placement PARTIAL (F11/D01).
lensPassEvidence.teacher: No teacher/admin API writes StudentMasteryProfile (all findMany reads); intelligence/interventions use getTeacherScope; placement review audited; student profile scoped (F03).
lensPassEvidence.guardian: assignments, attendance, student/[studentId], messages, report-cards verify StudentGuardian link; progress hides confusion internals (existing tests) and now supports child switching and no-evidence state (F06/F07).
lensPassEvidence.adminMoe: All MOE API routes gate on requireMoe*/isMoeSuperRole/platform admin; counties and dashboard suppress cohorts < 5; school detail page restricts non-platform admins to their school; approval service enforces school scope in canApprove.
lensPassEvidence.security: Middleware defaults to 401 for unauthenticated API calls; cron prefixes verified header-auth; heuristic sweep of 579 routes for missing auth and unscoped IDs; all hits triaged (F01-F04, F08, F09, D05, D06).
lensPassEvidence.accessibility: Contrast defect fixed globally with regression test (F14); notification control fixed (F15); no axe/jsx-a11y tooling exists in repo for automated coverage.
lensPassEvidence.operations: Login failures now reason-coded (F12); sync emits pending/conflict/dead-letter gauges with per-op resolution hints; per-learner support view missing (D02).
lensPassEvidence.failureRecovery: Offline sync uses operation ids and idempotency-key payload-mismatch detection; safe logout warns before discarding unsynced work; lesson completion replay fixed (F10).
lensPassEvidence.reachability: Literal portal links now all resolve (F13, regression test); redirect()/router.push targets verified; MOE live display unreachable (D03).

coreJourneys.journey: Student: today -> lesson -> exit ticket -> completion -> mastery
Teacher: dashboard -> student profile -> evidence -> intervention
Guardian: child selection -> attendance/assignments -> progress -> message
School admin: school-scoped dashboards and certificate share
MOE: national aggregates with small-cell protection

noNewEducationalAuthority: No new learner-state writers were added. lib/discussion/access.ts reuses the existing class/school scope rule; the evidenceCount field is read-only metadata.
externalOnlyReadiness: Supabase/Vercel unavailable: no live verification of fixes; deploy and post-deploy smoke pending.
Production build and PWA E2E are run by CI (ci.yml) - local dev box lacks memory for next build.
